title: A Space's leaders get a Leadership page in the console (yearly calendar and executive overview), and a Menswork website links to it with an Admin link

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-07: 'I also want the Executive Overview and Yearly Calendar in an admin gated area of the website. Create an obvious Admin link in the menu for the role.'

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. The website is cached, anonymous and on another domain, so it cannot gate anything: the gated area is a Space console page, /spaces/<slug>/manage/leadership, gated like every console page (resolveSpaceManageAccess, notFound for a non-manager, a janitor previews read-only). Two tabs. Yearly calendar: the Space's own events (drafts included, through listProgramYearEventRows in lib/calendar/admin-calendar.ts, the one module the publication gate test allows to opt out) laid over the Menswork seasons and the twelve sign start days (MENSWORK_SIGNS in lib/theme/menswork.ts), from the December lead-in through December; the year is derived from today and the events (pickProgramYear), never hardcoded; chips link to each event and take only a light look from the title. A month grid from md up, a day list below. Executive overview: owner-written Markdown on spaces.preferences.programOverview, rendered by the help Markdown renderer with a contents list, edited by managers through saveProgramOverview (gated, writes only that key, refreshes the site cache). The key never rides the public profile projection (toProfileContext strips it) and only lib/spaces/leadership.ts names it. The menu row is space.leadership in SPACE_MODULES under Gather. A website wearing the Menswork skin ends its header menu and phone menu with a labelled 'Admin' link to the page's absolute app URL.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const page=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/leadership/page.tsx');if(!/resolveSpaceManageAccess\(/.test(page)||!/if \(!canManage && !staffViewing\) notFound\(\)/.test(page))miss.push('the Leadership page is not gated like a console page');if(!/listProgramYearEventRows\(/.test(page)||!/readProgramOverview\(/.test(page))miss.push('the Leadership page does not read the calendar and the overview');if(!/manage\/leadership/.test(r('components/sites/site-page.tsx'))||!/hs-nav-admin/.test(r('components/sites/site-chrome.tsx')))miss.push('the website has no Admin link to the Leadership page');if(!/withoutLeadershipPreferences\(space\.preferences\)/.test(r('lib/spaces/profile-modules.ts')))miss.push('the public profile projection still carries the overview');if(!/id: 'space\.leadership'/.test(r('lib/admin/modules/space-modules.ts')))miss.push('the console menu has no Leadership row');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-862: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
